# MinimalNetworkModel

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reduced-order network model that captures core dynamical features of brain activity using the fewest possible nodes and connections. Guides the design of compact in-network neuromorphic substrates, reducing wiring complexity and energy consumption in TCC topologies.
